cards.card_text: For seven days, all the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths, and friend, after years in a junk drawer, a booth sounds like a BEACH HOUSE to me.
cards.verse_text: You are to dwell in booths for seven days.
cards.snippet: You are to dwell in booths for seven days.

cards.card_text: Why does He want them living in booths for seven days every year?
cards.verse_text: so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.
cards.snippet: …that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.

cards.card_text: In the Law they find what the LORD commanded through Moses, Israel's leader long ago: during the feast of the seventh month, the Israelites are to dwell in booths.
cards.verse_text: And they found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month, and that they should proclaim this message and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”

cards.card_text: To make the booths, the message tells people to go out to the hill country and bring back ___.
cards.verse_text: and that they should proclaim this message and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”
cards.snippet: …of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”

cards.card_text: Once they have the branches, the people build booths only inside the courts of the house of God.
cards.verse_text: And the people went out, brought back branches, and made booths on their own rooftops, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God, and in the squares by the Water Gate and by the Gate of Ephraim.

cards.card_text: The whole assembly back from exile makes booths and lives in them.
cards.verse_text: The whole assembly that had returned from exile made booths and lived in them.
cards.snippet: The whole assembly that had returned from exile made booths and lived in them.

cards.card_text: He lays it waste like a garden booth and destroys His place of meeting.
cards.verse_text: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting.
cards.snippet: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting.

cards.card_text: He spots a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth.
